name: crux
description: Local-first memory, retrieval, and receipts backend for agents (MCP over Streamable HTTP).
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a Crux Daemon: durable facts, token-budgeted retrieval, sessions, cross-agent handoffs, and receipted mutations. The daemon runs on your machine or your tailnet; nothing is sent anywhere else.

server_url.title: Crux MCP endpoint
server_url.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP URL. Defaults to a daemon on this machine. Another machine on your network: http://<host-or-tailnet-ip>:14801/mcp. Behind a TLS proxy: https://<your-host>/mcp (the MCP port is usually not exposed directly).

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: The daemon's CRUX_AGENT_TOKEN. Paste the raw token only — the 'Bearer ' prefix is added for you. Find it on the console's Connections page. Leave blank only if the daemon runs without token auth.
